response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack and systems engineer with deep experience in DLang, TypeScript/Node.js, distributed micro-services, and open-source leadership, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks the required 8 years of C++ programming (only brief C/C++ exposure at National Instruments ~6 months) and his infrastructure/distributed-systems experience, while present, is not centered on large-scale cloud compute platforms. His background is a poor match for a C++-centric cloud compute platform technical lead role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience (15+ years) across multiple domains and languages
Demonstrated technical leadership via mentoring, workshops, talks, and open-source project ownership (GISCollective)
Solid distributed systems exposure at Dunnhumby (low-latency, high-throughput micro-services)
concerns: Does not meet the 8-year C++ requirement — C++ experience is minimal and outdated (2014-2015 only)
No explicit experience with cloud compute platform architecture, hardware/storage architecture, or large-scale compute infrastructure ownership
Career trajectory is broad/generalist (web, mobile, DevOps, GIS) rather than deep specialization in cloud infrastructure leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform/infrastructure leadership focus
Strong general technical leadership and mentoring track record
